# Lending Policy Update Requirements

This document outlines key areas requiring urgent and audit-driven updates and optimization within the bank's lending policy:

*   Optimize the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Update the interest rates urgently.
*   Update the default risk quarterly.
*   Update the interest rates based on audit findings.
*   Optimize the borrower credit score urgently.
